differences: Input: real-human Wikimedia Commons titration clip (Maytouch L., CC-BY-SA-4.0), recording device UNKNOWN - not the original GRID phone capture; 2D lower-outline proxy with assumed 100 mm/427 px scale, horizontal plane, upright, constant height; no depth/6D reconstruction.

Gate: the original frozen A06 tracking gate (bottle base RMS<=5 mm/p95<=10 mm vs the 2D outline proxy) FAILS in every run (6.6-7.8 mm; neck-held flask swings ~5 deg). F is judged under the user-approved R1 gate (TCP-level fidelity, physical validity, swirl evidence vs a no-motion negative, amplitude ratio).

Teacher demos: planned joint-reference execution (CLOSED-038 path) at 3 positions; students: 034 C3 Cartesian controller on the identical 038 physics; grasp/lift/return/release are a shared scripted harness.

Student: phase-only open-loop swirl generator (MLP on Fourier K=24 phase features, 2000 updates, seed fixed, 3 demos). The 3 demos give identical (phase,label) rows, so it learns the teacher's video-derived command; it commands the video path exactly (0.00 mm). Feedback comes from the C3 executor; fresh-position generalization comes from the anchor-relative frame. Not an end-to-end visual policy; no time hold-out.

Three R1 attempts, all retained: 1 FAIL 0/2 (copycat student: state-input feedback, amplitude 2.92); 2 FAIL 1/2 (one 17.1 rad/s2 joint-6 count at flask touchdown in the shared lowering harness); 3 PASS 2/2 with untrained 0/2 after one harness change (lowering 6 s -> 12 s). The two pass-set positions were used in all three attempts. Supplementary new positions: 1 success, 3 NO_RESULT (own GPU guard stops).

R1 TCP-vs-video <=10 mm is not discriminative: the no-motion negative scores 5.43 mm and the student 5.55/5.59 mm, because the C3 executor realizes commands one 20 Hz tick late (~100 deg at 5.6 Hz). One-tick aligned: student 3.96/4.01 mm, x-corr 0.75/0.73; untrained 5.77 mm, x-corr -0.06. The trained-vs-untrained decision rests on amplitude ratio (0.73-0.74 vs 0.30).

Fluid: original MATTERIX PBD defaults, 125 particles, smoothed display points; retention by ideal cavity bookkeeping, no calibrated mass/volume. One particle escaped during initialization in a supplementary run (inflates its RMS to 287 mm; 16.6 mm without it).
Open harness weakness: grasp-close joint-6 acceleration spikes (15.06-15.6 rad/s2 vs 15.0 counter) occurred in 2 of the C3 runs; not addressed.

Video: live RTX render (10 fps, 35 s, 720x544) of a separate uncounted run with the pass-set phaseBC configuration (render addendum); that run also meets R1 (TCP 5.555 mm, amplitude 0.733, counts 0). Limits: 10 fps is below Nyquist for the 5.6 Hz, ~10 mm swirl, so the swirl appears aliased/small; glass renders cloudy and liquid motion is not visually discernible (a fill line is visible at rest). Motion and fluid evidence rest on logged metrics and the separate data-plot video.
